1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1317|c3ea1f53.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|c3ea1f53.text: You seem confident. Surely you wouldn't mind a test of your skills?

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

161-progress.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
161-progress.text: You say somethin', missy?  Can't hear a bloody thing besides the ringin' in me ears.  Say, what's that you got there?
161-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

469-progress.name: James Halloran
469-progress.text: Hello there, $c. Could I interest you in a pair of boots?  Perhaps some newly cured skins?
469-progress.title: Daily Delivery

92745-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92745-complete.text: Well done, $N. But I fear the source of the poison may lie somewhere else...
92745-complete.title: The State of the Mines

92747-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92747-accept.text:
Strange - the poison does not seem to originate from the mines you investigated.

I am told the Deadmines under the town of Moonbrook are the largest, deepest mines of Westfall, but they have been abandoned since the First War. Could the Deadmines be active again?

Please travel to Moonbrook, $N, and look for evidence of mining or industrial activity. This is the last lead we have!
92747-accept.title: Moonbrook Espionage

92748-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92748-accept.text:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748-accept.title: Explosive Consultation

92749-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92749-accept.text:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...
92749-accept.title: A Dynamite Plan

92750-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92750-accept.text:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750-accept.title: Detonation at a Distance

92750-complete.name: Jasper Fel
92750-complete.text: Hmm... Looking for something specific, are you?
92750-complete.title: Detonation at a Distance

92751-accept.name: Jasper Fel
92751-accept.text:
You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands.

If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers.

Oh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.
92751-accept.title: Detonation at a Distance

98197-accept.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-accept.text:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197-accept.title: Spoils of War

98282-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-accept.text:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282-accept.title: Alchemical Hazards
